<!-- stormworks-research-gap:mechanics:sensor-noise -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/mechanics/sensor-noise).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> The SDK documents sonar_noise and radar_noise as positive and negative ranges of small discrepancies in reported positions. Both defaults are 0.001. It separately describes radar_distance_noise, default 0.01, as a maximum percentage discrepancy in reported distance. The descriptions do not establish a distribution, update cadence or exact coordinate interpretation.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/9/body`

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> No Gaussian, uniform or distance-dependent noise formula is assumed. The SDK description does not by itself prove active radar or sonar error bounds.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/9/limitations/2`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: SDK radar and sonar noise defaults: resolve missing mechanics
